decided_by.description:
Who decided the approval, once someone has; nobody is named while it
waits for an Eligible approver (ADR 0135).

allow_always.description:
Whether the reader may choose "Always allow": they are the person the
Run's delegation chain starts at, the approval is still pending and its
kind can have a rule.

call.description: For a Tool call approval, the exact call the approver is asked to allow.

closed_reason.description: Why a `closed` approval or Run grant was closed, such as `run_ended`.

given_by.description:
What gave the approval in advance, under its owner's name: `{"rule": id}`
for one of their Approval Rules, `{"mode": "bypass"}` for the Bypass
mode, `{"mode": "auto", "decision": id}` for the approval Decider and its
Decision Evidence, and none when a person decided it.

kind.description:
`outbound` (an outbound read), `tool_call` (a call of a Tenant's tool
or of page reading), `sampling` or `grant` (a Run grant).

operation.description: For a Tool call approval, the operation of the tool the call invokes.

plugin_tool.description:
For a Tool call approval of a tool a Run pinned from an Agent Plugin, or a Run grant
from one, the plugin, server and tool, and the plugin copy that declared them. `tool` and
`version` then hold the tool's path and the copy's digest.

refused_by.description:
What refused the approval in advance, with no one asked: `{"rule": id}`
for one of the owner's Approval Rules, `{"mode": "dont_ask"}` for the
Don't ask mode, and `{"mode": "auto", "reason": ...}` for the approval
Decider, whose reason names a block category or `unavailable`. None when
a person decided it or it is still open.

tool.description:
For a Tool call approval, or a Run grant from one, the Tenant's tool and
its definition version.

viewer_can_decide_inline.description:
The card is a pending outbound or tool call approval that
the reader decides as its requester and the person at the root of the
Run's delegation chain, so the Thread may offer it inline.

viewer_is_approver.description:
Whether the reader acts on this card as an Eligible approver: for a
pending approval, they may decide it now (ADR 0135); for a Run grant, they
may approve its kind for its destination now; for another approval, they
decided or gave it and still may approve it. Either way they may revoke it.

PluginName.description:
A plugin name: 1-64 characters of `a-z0-9.-`, starting and ending alphanumeric, with neither
`--` nor `..`.

Concurrency.description:
Whether a tool's calls may share a Tool Batch. Registry configuration can
only lower a provider's declaration, never raise it.

oneOf.description: Every call runs alone, in the model's order.
Read-only calls whose provider derives Resource Claims and an output bound.

lifetime_seconds.description:
How long a generated agent lasts; absent means as long as its Task, with
no maximum.

max_agents.description:
How many agents the policy may generate in all; absent means no cap
(#1012, ADR 0143).

max_concurrent.description: How many may be active at once; absent means no cap.

max_depth.description: How deeply generated agents may generate in turn; absent means no cap.

token_budget.description:
How many tokens the policy's generated agents may use in all; absent
means no token limit. Money Budgets are the limit then (#1012
decision 41, ADR 0143).

tokens_per_agent.description:
How many tokens one generated agent may use; absent means no token
limit. Required with `token_budget`, which it is reserved against.

memory.description:
Home-owned native memory model roles. The ancestor's total token budget
and the pinned memory workflow's call/token/cost caps both apply.

Narrowing.description:
No effect, replay, approval or disclosure field is accepted here. Concurrency
safety may only be lowered; a claim above the provider's is rejected.

RemoteSemanticProvider.description:

max_calls_per_run.description: A lower per-Run call limit than the Decider version declares.

preserve_recent.description: Events, or on the Native Projection Version Model Turns, never classified.

threshold.description:
The probability at which an answer takes the conservative action; lower
is stricter. A Route's own threshold is intersected in when it is asked.

instructions and picks components within what a person set here, instead of
copying the template unchanged. The template still supplies everything the
draft does not name.

ContextRecoveryFailure.description:
Why a Run paused instead of sending or acting on a provider request.
Each reason is final for its step; none of them is retried as transport.

ControlSource.description:
The kind of actor that last changed a Run's control. It is shown to anyone
who can see the Run; the person and the reason are not.

oneOf.description: A Tenant Subject, or the Run's creation.

DeclinedCall.description: A call a person declined; the worker answers it with the kind's fixed sentence.

DegradedContext.description: What a Run remembers about its Degraded context.

count.description: Every step that ran with Degraded context.

outage.description:
Set by a degraded step and cleared by a retrieval that succeeds. While
it is set a step tries once and degrades at once if that try fails,
instead of waiting for the bounded retry again.

recent.description: The latest of those steps, oldest first.

DeploymentIdentity.description:
`GET /.well-known/aidash`: the Deployment's identity and its Deployment Key.
It names no Node; Nodes belong to Tenants and are not public.

key.description:
Absent when the Deployment has no Deployment Key, so it cannot federate
with other Deployments.

key_rollover.description: A published normal transition, containing public keys and proof only.

id.description: The token `kid`, which a Tenant Administrator types to pin this key.

public_key_pem.description: SubjectPublicKeyInfo PEM of the Ed25519 public key.

node.description: The Node of the Thread or executing Run; none for a Tenant-level event.

HomeApproval.description:
The answer a Run executing for another Node received from that Node's
human request, for the exact call it was asked about.

answer_by.description:
When the Run waiting for this question continues without an answer, if
its person set an Answer Deadline. State and Human Request listings fill
it from the Run's waiting state.

LeaseWait.description: Why a Run that no worker currently holds is not being claimed.

oneOf.description: Only a worker that understands these capabilities may claim the Run.

ModelFileSelection.description: A one-inference file reference can additionally name a creator-owned Subnode Area.

thread_id.description: Saved as `workspace_id` in a Run's `pending` before #1008.

shape.

provider_activity.description: Observable provider-owned activity, never Research evidence or citations.

reasoning.description:
The provider's reasoning, exactly as received (#942). Kept in the
pending state so a resumed step records it with its Model Turn; omitted
when absent, so responses without reasoning keep their JSON shape.

PausedCall.description: The call an Authority Pause stopped, recorded only when it certainly did not run.

tool_call.description: Exact input at the authority check; absent on pauses saved by older workers.

ask.description:
The tool and the sides that lack it, when a Federation tool list stopped the call
(ADR 0139). The people who hold those lists answer from it.

connection_refusals.description: Transport-proven, still-unsatisfied refusals. Tool result JSON never populates these.

connection_waited.description: Survives context compaction and prevents repeated failure deferrals.

context_reason.description: Typed context-recovery reason for a paused Run; cleared on resume.

decider_retry.description:
Outage retries of the current step's decision after every
Decider Route failed. A decision commits to it, so each retry asks the
Routes again; it is reset once the step saves anything else (ADR 0066).

decision_cycle.description:
How many times a person resumed this Run from a pause. A decision
commits to it, so a resume starts a new decision while a
recovered lease continues the same one (#108).

declined_calls.description:
Calls a person declined, kept until the worker has answered them. Separate from
`paused_call`: an earlier sibling of a Tool Batch can pause the Run again first.

degraded.description: Steps that ran with Degraded context (ADR 0059). Kept across resumes.

early_abandoned_tasks.description: Unassigned Tasks this Run abandoned before it could finish.

lease_recoveries.description: Consecutive Lease Recoveries of the current step.

node_retry.description:
Retries of the current step after another Node did not answer a check
(#751). A retry asks again, so it is reset once the step saves anything
else.

paused_call.description:
The tool call an Authority Pause stopped, when a person may decline it (#763). Cleared on
resume; people never read it, only whether they may decline.

remote_task_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of remote terminal child Tasks observed before inference.
